evaluation_policy.source_time_rule: If the source interval is later in phase order than the receiver interval, the source interval is lifted by -T_cyc. Same-interval diagonal contacts require a diagonal-exclusion subledger before acceptance.
evaluation_policy.interval_method: Exact rational row time ranges are combined with certified row-specific X_delta ranges from rational pi and Taylor trigonometric enclosures. A row is accepted as empty when the receiver and source null-coordinate intervals are strictly disjoint, or when a same-interval row has a strict exact-rational derivative floor proving monotone diagonal exclusion. A regular non-seam subrow is certified as simple_root only when the source null coordinate is strictly monotone, an oriented source-inner range strictly covers the receiver range, and the causal memory depth has strict lower and horizon margins. Parent complements are probed by strict range-empty separation against the full source interval, but parent consumption also requires endpoint/topology ownership not supplied by this sidecar.
evaluation_policy.pass_rule: This artifact passes only if every row is accepted as empty, simple_root, or fold_layer with no split_required rows. This v5 sidecar accepts range-empty and monotone diagonal-exclusion rows, records simple-root subwindow certificates, and probes parent complements, but no complete parent-complement consumption, seam endpoint ownership, or fold-layer rows.
evaluation_policy.v6_pass_rule: A parent complement is accepted only by one accepted alternative. Since no v6 strip satisfies strict range-empty, endpoint/topology ownership, exact fold-family coverage, or regular-boundary coverage, every parent remains split_required.
evaluation_policy.v7_pass_rule: A parent complement is accepted only by a certified same-packet ownership-data record. Candidate regular-boundary core tables are diagnostic until inclusion, domination, topology/no-double-counting, and non-core complement closure fields are supplied.
evaluation_policy.v8_pass_rule: Finite candidate family listing is not acceptance. Regular-boundary coverage requires exact single separator assignment, certified same-packet inclusion, certified domination or enlarged same-packet ceiling, topology/no-double-counting, and non-core complement closure.

source_range_backend.limitation: This certificate certifies range-empty rows, same-interval monotone diagonal exclusions, and simple-root subwindows, then probes receiver-side parent complements for strict range-empty gaps. It does not certify periodic seam endpoint ownership, fold-layer rows, dynamic residuals, endpoint/topology ownership for parent partitions, or complete parent-complement consumption.

source_range_backend.v6_probe_backend: No new trigonometric range enclosure is computed. v6 imports v5 exact-rational complement ranges and tests accepted ownership and coverage fields against the current same-packet artifact set.

source_range_backend.v7_probe_backend: No new trigonometric range enclosure is computed. v7 imports v6 complement records and constructs same-packet endpoint, fold-family, and regular-boundary candidate data from fresh packet artifacts.

interval_method.v8_probe_backend: No new trigonometric range enclosure is computed. v8 builds finite regular-boundary candidate families from the v7 cores and audits missing proof fields.
